question: What is the meaning of instructions on how to recover materials at end-of-life in relation to material recovery information?
data_point: instructions on how to recover materials at end-of-life
description: Instructions on how to recover materials at end-of-life refer to the process of disassembly and sorting of materials to facilitate their reuse, remanufacturing, recycling, or proper disposal. This information is crucial for the circular economy and helps to minimize waste and conserve resources.
